fusions.name: Anvil Throw
fusions.desc: Hurls an iron weight up to 7 tiles for 13 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range, and stuns the target for 1 second.

fusions.name: Ring Bell
fusions.desc: A heavy, even blow that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Cold Bulwark
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% and your physical resistance by 15% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Unyielding Hide
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%. Every ability you have comes round 5% sooner.
